scope: Validated rectangular PPTX merges projected as sparse logical Table origins; native source bindings retain physical coordinates

implementation.reader: Only merge origins become TableCell nodes; fully covered rows retain empty logical cells lists
implementation.validation: Physical rectangular grid, bounded spans, nonoverlapping complete ownership and exact hMerge/vMerge flags
implementation.fallback: Unproved topology or text in a continuation retains every physical cell and emits located pptx.table-grid loss; unchanged source export retains all payloads, edited unproved cells refuse atomically
implementation.widths: Original point widths for PPTX; general grid_widths_twips rounded to the Model unit for other routes
implementation.rebuild: Bounded native_grid places sparse spans; direct continuation appearance restored only for matching physical owner identity and current merge coverage
implementation.source: Logical cell index maps to validated physical row/column; existing physical v3 snapshots supported; v1/v2 retain previous scope
implementation.ownership: Formats-owned properties and parsers only; no new Model DTO, dependency or contract

checks.wheel_sdist: release 0.42.0 archives, licenses, metadata and resources verified

minimal_pptx_profile.scope: Installed wheel, opaque package, two JSON cycles, merged logical origins, source cell and Box edits, native rebuild
minimal_pptx_profile.license_inventory_scope: Reviewed uv.lock is unchanged; this smoke additionally checks xlsxwriter 3.3.1, while the lock pins 3.3.0

checks.regression_command: python -m pytest tests/readers tests/writers tests/support/test_ooxml_pptx_package.py tests/support/test_ooxml_package.py -k 'pptx or office_export_cancellation or ooxml_package' -q --tb=short

native_acceptance.edits: Merged origin, first styled run after horizontal merge, plain insertion into empty cell

limits: Not full layout/theme fidelity for rebuild or cross-format page layout
Invalid merges and hidden continuation content remain explicitly unproved physical projection
No arbitrary source structure/style/run topology editing or automatic repair
ZIP metadata/archive byte identity and signatures outside the accepted edit profile
